subject: Is it possible to have hjust option in geom_tippoint?

messages.author: 0636c591dc0d6576
messages.subject: Is it possible to have hjust option in geom_tippoint?
parts:
Hi,

I am loving the package. It definitely makes working with trees lot easier and reproducible.

I was wondering if it is possible to move points from geom_tippoint() as you would move geom_tiplabel() using hjust option.

Thank you.
migun

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to have hjust option in geom_tippoint?
parts: there is not hjust parameter in geom_tippoint. If you want to move the points you need to prepare a data frame and pass it to geom_tippoint().

On Saturday, April 23, 2016 at 1:13:10 AM UTC+8, Migun Shakya wrote:

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to have hjust option in geom_tippoint?
parts:
I did that using following:

p %<+% gtype + geom_tippoint(aes(color=V2), size=4)

However, I am still confused how do I move the points?

Thank you
